title: Overlapping work and dependencies
description: A Gantt timeline encodes duration, overlap and a milestone. It differs from an ordered step guide because tasks occupy explicit intervals.

data.source:
gantt
    title Illustrative course preparation
    dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
    axisFormat %d %b
    section Content
    Outline :a, 2026-10-05, 2d
    Write lessons :b, after a, 4d
    section Review
    Prepare rubric :c, 2026-10-06, 3d
    Review lessons :d, after b, 2d
    Release :milestone, after d, 0d
